description: City Hall Electricity Usage is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment Department. Electric power load at City Hall (1 City Hall Square) measured every 15 minutes. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Environment Department. Its tags are City Hall, demand, electric, energy, load. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2020-06-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
